[[Unholy Burst#Unholy Burst|Unholy Burst 6]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Unholy Burst#Unholy Burst|Unholy Burst 6]]:''' This weapon is a sinister implement of evil deeds, dealing 6d6 Evil damage on a successful hit to Good enemies, and 14d6 Evil damage on a critical hit to Good enemies. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned.
Good characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
